description: This Java source file defines the SecureActivity class, which extends Android's Activity class. The onResume() method checks if the device is secured according to a policy, and if not, redirects the user to a policy setup screen.

classes.name: SecureActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that checks device security policy on resume and redirects to setup if not secured.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Overrides Activity.onResume() to verify device security and potentially redirect to a setup activity.
